summary: Independent read-only correctness review completed with no blocking defects identified. Inspected actual build, platform, browser and development-test code against the supplied engine. Callback signatures match; retained startup arguments have module lifetime; framebuffer conversion correctly produces opaque RGBA from 0x00RRGGBB and reacquires growable-memory views. Keydown/up handling covers repeats, modifier aliases and focus-loss releases. Ctrl and Space emit the supplied engine's KEY_FIRE (0xa3) and KEY_USE (0xa2), matching m_controls.c and the G_BuildTiccmd action path. The monotonic clock returns milliseconds, the engine controls 35 Hz simulation timing, and Asyncify-backed sleep covers nested tic synchronization and screen-wipe waits without overlapping tick callbacks. Supplied evidence records a successful build and development tests; both negative controls fail at the intended engine action assertions. The source diff contains no engine or asset changes, and packaged doom.data matches the recorded supplied WAD SHA256. This is a static correctness pass, not browser gameplay acceptance: no commands or browser tests were executed by this read-only reviewer, and snapshot hashes were taken from the assigned evidence rather than independently recomputed. No other reviewer or coder conclusions were consulted. Review is complete; no further activity is scheduled by this reviewer.
